findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: The food items in the double doors stainless steel cooler adjacent to the triple sink in the kitchen were observed at a higher temperature than 50F. The volunteers in the kitchen said that they had just moved the items to that cooler a little while ago. The items were removed and placed in the four compartment cooler in the serving area. Ensure that food items in a cold holding unit are held within the range of 41F and below at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: The double doors stainless steel cooler in the kitchen was observed not keeping the appropriate temperature. PIC assured inspector that the cooler will be repair in due time. No food items will be store with in the unit until the necessary repairs are done.  All the hanging thermometers within the unit measured at 51, 55, and 54. The laser thermometer read at 57 for ambient temperature. Ensure the cooler is repaired to enable it to capacitate the adequate temperature range.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.

findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [PF]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Inspector observed foods requiring refrigeration to be stored in the bar reach in cooler with a temperature of 55F. Two partial bottles of bloody mary mix, an eighth of a bottle of Simply orange, approximately half of a bottle of simply lemon, a portion of olives, cherries, and jalapeños were all voluntarily discarded out of an abundance of caution. Containers read refrigerate after opening and keep refrigerated. 
The glass front cooler next to the reach in is cold and has room to hold the tray of drink garnishes, Freshly open bloody mary mix and other items like the simply juice that require refrigeration. Post reach in cooler to be used for unopened items only.
Continue to use the cold cooler for garnishes or open food that requires refrigeration. TCS foods are foods that require temperature control for safety. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

Store cleaners and other toxic items properly separated from food related items. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

Repeat: Observed the following surfaces are soiled: 1.outside doors of the refrigerators and freezers, 2.fan guards and blades, 3.windowsill in the kitchen, 4.inside the refrigerator with 'the friendly post' magnet, 5.ice maker drain.  
New Violation: 6.Observed the outsides of the microwaves in the kitchens to be soiled.  Clean the microwaves. 
Clean these items and maintain clean.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Repeat: Observed clean pitchers, a cutting board and a knife stored on a cloth towel.  Allow equipment to air dry and do not store on an absorbent surface.
750-840 All equipment, tableware and utensils shall be air-dried.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed unprotected styrofoam bowls and plastic cups.  Store inverted or covered.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the kitchen hand sink to be soiled.  Clean the hand sink and maintain clean.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Repeat: Observed the floor to be soiled in the following locations: 1.under the fryers, 2.under the keg cooler, 3.under the ice maker in the beer room, 4.between the wall and storage shelf in the beer room, 5.under the hand sink in the beer room, 6.around the water heater in the beer room.  Clean the floor and maintain clean.
New violations: 7.Observed an accumulation of grease on the floor to the left of the oven.  Clean the floor and maintain clean.  2.Observed loose coving in the beer room.  Reattach the coving to the wall.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Repeat: Observed a hole in the wall in the beer room into the furnace room.  Repair the wall.
New violation: Observed an accumulaiton of dust on the ceiling fans in the kitchen and beer room.  Clean the fans of the dust.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed an opened bag of shredded cheddar cheese without a date label.  Label potentially hazardous food with the use by date.  Corrected: the cheese was discarded.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
1.Observed ice scoops stored on top of the ice maker on a cotton cloth.  Store the scoops in the ice with the handle extended or on a clean surface.
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1.Observed cracked caulk at the hand sink in the kitchen.  Re-caulk the sink to the wall, 2.Observed absorbent, rough surfaces on the edges of the cabinets at the bar.  Seal the rough edges so they are non-absorbent.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The following surfaces are soiled: 1.mildew inside the water reservoir of the two ice makers, 2.inside the three microwaves - all surfaces including the tops and sides.  Clean and sanitize these items and maintain clean.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following surfaces are soiled: 1.outside doors of the refrigerators and freezers, 2.fan guards and blades, 3.windowsill in the kitchen, 3.inside refrigerator ('The Friendly Post' magnet), 4.scum on the ice maker drain, 5.legs of the ice bins.  Clean these items and maintain clean.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
1.Observed utensils at the bar improperly stored.  Store with the handles extended. 2.Observed clean utensils and pitchers stored on a cotton cloth.  Allow to air dry and do not store on an absorbent surface.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.
750-840 All equipment, tableware and utensils shall be air-dried.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Did not observe self-closing devices on one of the men's, one of the women's and the unisex bathroom.  Provide self-closing doors.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed a build-up of debris on the floor in the following locations: 1.under ovens and fryers, 2.under the keg cooler, 3.under the ice maker, 4.between the wall and black plastic storage shelving in the beer room, 5.under the hand sink in the beer room, 6. around the hot water heater in the beer room, 7.under the ice bin at the bar.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a hole in the wall in the beer room into the furnace room.  Repair the hole.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed a can of Lysol spray on a shelf above sugar and crackers.  Store toxics below or separate from food-related items.  Corrected: Lysol was moved.
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed ice scoops stored on top of the ice maker on a cotton cloth.  Properly store the ice scoops either in the ice with the handle extended or on a clean surface.
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.comment:
Observed cracked caulk at the kitchen hand sink.  Re-caulk the sink to the wall.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.comment:

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800b Food contact surfaces shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized any time they may have become contaminated.  The ice machine in the canteen is soiled with mold. Wash, rinse and sanitize the ice machine so that ice is food quality.

findings.title: Rooms and equipment - vented as required
findings.comment: 750-1250 All rooms shall have sufficient ventilation to keep them free of excessive, heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes. The surfaces in the kitchen range from 100F to 104F. No food prep is taking place and the temperature outside is not predicted to exceed 86F today. Provide adequate ventilation.
